description: This Java source file defines the class 'X509AuthHandler', which is a handler for authenticating MQTT clients using X.509 certificates. It extends 'ExecutionContextAuthHandler' and implements logic to parse credentials by extracting peer certificates from the SSL session and validating them using provided authentication services.

classes.name: X509AuthHandler
classes.description: A handler for authenticating an MQTT client using an X.509 client certificate, extending ExecutionContextAuthHandler and implementing certificate validation logic.

methods.name: X509AuthHandler
methods.description: Constructor initializing the handler with client authentication service and provider, ensuring non-null arguments.

methods.name: parseCredentials
methods.description: Parses credentials from the MQTT context by extracting and validating the client's certificate, returning a future containing a JsonObject if successful or a failure if validation fails.
